title: Home Decor
description: This mod adds various decorative blocks.
body:
##
⚠️ This mod is in development! ⚠️
![what](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0991e5637e3b1e3bbc87748d7c5a4fa3c5b1783.png) **Home Decor is a mod that adds tons of new blocks with custom models to beautify your world. The mod includes 2 categories where you will find:** - Big Bottles - Trash - Wall Shelfes ![x](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9de36d07a95b06f61884aaef68c7369d2ef69a4_0.webp) ![x](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9de36d07a95b06f61884aaef68c7369d2ef69a4_0.webp) #### Suggestions? Contact me via Discord _(dievoglio)_! I'm open to ideas that will help improve the modification. ### License: This mod is licensed under **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**.
